meta.name: add-ollama-tool
meta.description: Add Ollama MCP server so the container agent can call local models and optionally manage the Ollama model library.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让容器 agent 调用本地大模型并管理模型库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在容器中运行本地大模型并管理模型库
copy.tagline_en: Enable container agent to call local models and manage model library
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to run local LLMs in containers and manage model libraries

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把部分任务交给本机 Ollama 运行的本地模型处理,新增“列出模型”“生成回答”等工具;可选开启“拉取/删除模型”等管理工具。Claude 仍负责整体编排。
howto.when: 当你提到“ollama”或要求用本地模型回答、查模型列表时触发;若已开启管理工具,也可响应拉取、删除模型的指令。

say.text: 用 ollama 告诉我法国的首都
say.note: Claude 会先列模型,再生成回答。

say.text: 列出当前可用的 ollama 模型
用 ollama 拉取 gemma3:1b 模型

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can delegate parts of tasks to local models served by Ollama on this machine. It gains tools to list models and generate responses, and optionally manage the model library (pull/delete). Claude remains the orchestrator.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention "ollama" or ask to use local models for answering or listing models; if admin tools are enabled, it can also respond to pull/delete model commands.

say_en.text: Use ollama to tell me the capital of France
say_en.note: Claude lists models then generates the answer.

say_en.text: Use ollama to pull the gemma3:1b model
